name: SIGINT
standfirst: Security research and practitioner news, scored for novelty and actionability.
colophon: sigint.wtf — the correct response to most of these CVEs. Scored by machine against a hand-written rubric; ranking is opinion, not fact.

items.title: QUASAR: A Quantum-Classical Neural Network for SAR Satellite Physical-Layer Authentication
items.dek: Quantum-classical hybrid network for X-band SAR satellite authentication uses 10% less training data than classical baselines.
